summary: Closing F1 re-census (PB-011C protocol, kernel door door_version 2, fresh python per row, serial, quiet machine at HEAD 07b2090 post-ADM-004/post-F1-AUTHORING-ARMS). ALL 21 F1 manifest rows were re-run through corpus/ttc/door.py --engine truck: ZERO rows certified on this dispatch - no row flipped typed-refusal to certified-lift, so no kernel timing column is appended and the timing table carries no new kernel column (A2 21 median lines holds unchanged). Verdict split: 12 typed-refusal rows at authoring carriers (Plane frame algebra via surfaces.half_section_face [diffuser, drivetrain, floor, monocoque, power_unit]; Pos placement [corner_fl/fr/rl/rr]; Spline airfoil-profile authoring [beam_wing, engine_cover, rear_wing]), and 9 kernel-door DNF (untyped) rows on the drop-in Vector data-row surface (airbox, details, drs_actuator, drs_flap, steering_rack, suspension_front, suspension_rear, track_rod_left, track_rod_right). No F1 row reaches a boolean op under the truck regime: the rows stop in authoring, so the ADM-004 admission state is not exercised by any F1 row's kernel-door run and the certified-funnel boolean admission is unreachable behind the authoring surface. Delta vs pre-admission census: admission cured none at the door; all 21 rows keep refusing (12 typed / 9 untyped DNF); the PB-011B LIFT EVIDENCE / PB-011C CENSUS / PB-011 LIFT EVIDENCE markers in corpus/ttc/SKIPS.json are unchanged and the corpus manifest is untouched. OCC-baseline door evidence (door_version 1, one fresh process per row): 21/21 green, reproducing the recorded corpus/ttc/reference/<row>.json facts BIT-IDENTICALLY (no drift, no OCC flake - both stop conditions did not fire). The census table in docs/TTC_CENSUS_FINAL.md carries all 21 rows with per-row kernel-door verdicts, first-refusing carrier classes, kernel wall_s, OCC-baseline door-evidence columns (solid_count, STL tris, wall_s), and the delta vs the pre-admission census.

findings.title: No F1 row certifies on the admitted kernel door at this HEAD - the authoring surface is the standing boundary
findings.detail: Re-running all 21 F1 rows through corpus/ttc/door.py --engine truck at HEAD 07b2090 (post ADM-004 + F1-AUTHORING-ARMS) returns ZERO green rows. Every row stops in authoring before reaching any boolean: 12 refuse typed at authoring carriers (Plane frame algebra in surfaces.half_section_face; Pos placement in wheels.build_corner; Spline airfoil-profile authoring in surfaces.airfoil_profile), and 9 die untyped on the drop-in Vector data row (no .normalized/.X/scalar-mul/difference; ctor accepts only tuple/list/3-scalar). Because no F1 row reaches its boolean op under the truck regime, the ADM-004 certified-funnel admission is never exercised by an F1 row's kernel-door run.

findings.title: Delta vs pre-admission census: admission cured none of the F1 rows at the kernel door
findings.detail: The pre-admission census (PB-011B/PB-011C/PB-011) recorded the F1 rows by their first-refusing boolean op class at the certified funnel (12 canonical-cutter rows PB-011B LIFT EVIDENCE, 8 swept-x-swept rows PB-011C CENSUS typed-refusal, monocoque PB-011 LIFT EVIDENCE). The closing kernel-door re-run measures the actual corpus execution, which stops in AUTHORING - earlier than the boolean the funnel consult classifies - so none of the adjudicated statuses flipped to a door-level certified-lift. The SKIPS markers and manifest are unchanged; the measured boundary is the authoring surface, booked for the FSSI-002/003 / authoring-surface follow-ups the packet names.

findings.title: The 9 untyped rows are drop-in data-row surface gaps, recorded verbatim, not tuned
findings.detail: airbox/details die at plate_plane's bd.Vector(...).normalized(); drs_actuator at cp.X; drs_flap at Vector*float; steering_rack/suspension x2/track rods x2 at Vector-Vector. As with the FH tube() rows before F1-AUTHORING-ARMS and the hypercar interior/lighting rows, these are authoring-surface DNFs the drop-in should answer or refuse typed; recorded as-is per the census protocol.

findings.title: OCC-baseline references for all 21 rows reproduce bit-identically (21/21)
findings.detail: Every F1 row's OCC door run (door_version 1) reproduced the recorded corpus/ttc/reference/<row>.json facts bit-exactly (solid_count, volume, bbox). The green-side reference set is trustworthy; no reference drift and no OCC flake (Null TopoDS_Shape) occurred.

notes: docs/TTC_CENSUS_FINAL.md carries all 21 rows' final verdicts with the per-row carrier-collision and OCC-baseline door-evidence columns plus the delta against the pre-admission census; anchors hold (A1 48 on the unchanged MANIFEST, A2 21 median lines in docs/TT_TIMING_RESULTS.md, which gains no kernel column because no F1 row flipped green). Typed refusals are valid outcomes (measurement, not a lift packet); no row was tuned, no corpus script was edited, no benchmark timing was performed (no green row), and no concurrent door runs were made.
